fullPassage: Digital platforms have made a lot of work less sticky. As work becomes ever more modularised, commoditised and standardised, and as markets for digital work are created, ties between service work and particular places can be disconnected. While the business process of outsourcing that emerged in the 1990s allowed large companies to take advantage of a 'global reserve army' by moving their call centres to cheap and distant labour markets, cloudwork changes the volume and granularity at which geographically non-proximate work can take place. A small business in New York can hire a freelance transcriber in Nairobi one day and New Delhi the next. No offices or factories need to be built, no local regulations are observed, and — in most cases — no local taxes are paid. The switch in the production network of work happens by simply sending some emails or clicking some buttons on a digital work platform. And, in this way, the employer leaves behind no material traces in the places where it was once an employer.

questions.passage:
(A) Digital platforms have made a lot of <u>work</u> less sticky.

(B) The switch in the production network of <u>work</u> happens by simply sending some emails or clicking some buttons on a digital work platform.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 work의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) work = 노동/일. 디지털 플랫폼이 많은 일을 덜 고정적으로 만들었다. (B) work = 업무. 업무의 생산 네트워크 전환.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 작동하다/직장: (A)에서 동사가 아닌 명사, (B)에서 직장이 아닌 업무
❌ ② 노동/작품: (B)는 예술 작품이 아닌 업무 과정
✅ ③ (A) 노동 — (B) 업무: (A)는 추상적 '노동' 개념, (B)는 구체적 '업무' 과정 ←정답
❌ ④ 작품/노동: (A)는 작품이 아닌 노동
det.tip: work: 노동(추상적 개념) vs 업무(구체적 과정). 문맥에 따라 의미가 달라짐

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the level of detail or precision in a set of data or a process"

det.korean: granularity(세분성): 데이터나 과정에서의 세부 수준 또는 정밀도.
det.analysis:
❌ ① volume(양): 양이지 세부 정밀도가 아님
❌ ② capacity(용량): 수용 능력이지 세밀도가 아님
✅ ③ granularity(세분성): 영영풀이에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ frequency(빈도): 발생 횟수이지 세부 수준이 아님
det.tip: granularity = 세분성, 세밀도. 작업이 더 작은 단위로 나뉠 수 있는 정도

questions.passage: As work becomes ever more modularised, commoditised and __________ (standard), and as markets for digital work are created, ties between service work and particular places can be disconnected.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: standard(기준) → standardised(표준화된). modularised, commoditised와 병렬 구조이므로 과거분사(-ised) 형태 필요.
det.analysis: standard(명사/형용사: 기준/표준의) → standardise(동사: 표준화하다) → standardised(과거분사/형용사: 표준화된). 병렬 구조(modularised, commoditised and ____)에서 동일 어미 필요.
det.tip: standard → standardise → standardised. 병렬 구조 파악이 핵심

questions.passage: The switch in the production network of work happens by __________ (simple) sending some emails or clicking some buttons on a digital work platform.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: simple(형용사: 단순한) → simply(부사: 단순히). 동명사 sending을 수식하는 부사가 필요.
det.analysis: simple(형용사: 단순한) → simply(부사: 단순히). 'by ______ sending some emails' — 동명사(sending)를 수식하므로 부사 형태가 필요. 'simply sending' = 단순히 보내는 것만으로.
det.tip: simple(형용사) → simply(부사). 동명사를 수식하는 부사 형태

questions.passage: Digital platforms have made a lot of work less sticky. As work becomes ever more modularised, commoditised and standardised, and as markets for digital work are created, ties between service work and particular places can be disconnected. While the business process of outsourcing that emerged in the 1990s allowed large companies to take advantage of a 'global reserve army' by moving their call centres to cheap and distant labour markets, cloudwork changes the volume and granularity at which geographically non-proximate work can take place. A small business in New York can hire a freelance transcriber in Nairobi one day and New Delhi the next. No offices or factories need to be built, no local regulations are observed, and — in most cases — no local taxes are paid. The switch in the production network of work happens by simply __________ on a digital work platform. And, in this way, the employer leaves behind no material traces in the places where it was once an employer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이메일을 보내거나 버튼을 클릭하는 것만으로. 업무 생산 네트워크의 전환이 간단한 디지털 행위로 이루어진다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① building new offices or factories: 본문에서 사무실/공장 건설이 불필요하다고 했으므로 반대
❌ ② observing local regulations and paying taxes: 본문에서 규정 준수/세금 납부가 안 된다고 했으므로 반대
❌ ③ hiring permanent employees in each country: 프리랜서 고용이 핵심이므로 정규직 고용은 반대
✅ ④ sending some emails or clicking some buttons: 'happens by simply ______' — 간단한 디지털 행위로 전환 ←정답
det.tip: 디지털 전환은 이메일이나 버튼 클릭만으로 이루어진다는 핵심 내용

ch: observing local regulations and paying taxes
hiring permanent employees in each country
sending some emails or clicking some buttons

questions.passage: Digital platforms have made a lot of work less sticky. As work becomes ever more modularised, commoditised and standardised, and as markets for digital work are created, __________ can be disconnected. While the business process of outsourcing that emerged in the 1990s allowed large companies to take advantage of a 'global reserve army' by moving their call centres to cheap and distant labour markets, cloudwork changes the volume and granularity at which geographically non-proximate work can take place. A small business in New York can hire a freelance transcriber in Nairobi one day and New Delhi the next. No offices or factories need to be built, no local regulations are observed, and — in most cases — no local taxes are paid. The switch in the production network of work happens by simply sending some emails or clicking some buttons on a digital work platform. And, in this way, the employer leaves behind no material traces in the places where it was once an employer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 서비스 노동과 특정 장소 사이의 연결. 디지털 노동 시장이 생성되면서 이 연결이 끊어질 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the business process of outsourcing: 외주화 과정 자체가 끊어지는 것이 아님
✅ ② ties between service work and particular places: '______ can be disconnected' — 서비스 노동과 장소의 연결이 끊어짐 ←정답
❌ ③ a small business in New York: 뉴욕 사업체가 단절되는 맥락 아님
❌ ④ the volume and granularity of cloudwork: 양과 세분성이 단절되는 것이 아님
det.tip: ties = 연결, 유대. 서비스 노동과 장소의 ties가 단절될 수 있다

ch: ties between service work and particular places
a small business in New York
the volume and granularity of cloudwork
